finalText:
All 625 tests pass, and the ground-truth verifier confirms it.

The bug: `orderTotal` in `src/pricing.js` computed tax on the original price instead of the discounted price, even though its own comment said tax should apply after the discount. Fixed by taxing the discounted amount (`applyTax(discounted, taxRate)`), which only showed up in rows where both a discount and a tax were non-zero — most rows had one or the other at zero, masking the bug.
